vehicle_profile: South-African motorcycle commuter/utility; cargo variant must be separately parameterized and qualified
tire_baseline_rule: Use at least one named, legally appropriate commercial control tire of the same approved size, load/speed rating, rim and declared duty cycle. Do not compare unmatched sizes or tire states.
evidence_gate: No candidate is promotable on simulation/optimization alone. Mandatory physical and legal qualification is a hard gate before road use.

variables: DOT or production batch where available
cases.promotion_gate: Every subsequent result joins to exact specimen, rim, pressure, condition and configuration.

cases.method_reference: ISO 18164:2026; verify current applicable method and licensed standard text
cases.target: Research stretch: at least 10% lower measured rolling resistance vs matched control, while wet/dry force envelopes remain within a pre-registered non-inferiority margin.
cases.promotion_gate: Matched tire state and test method; repeatability and parasitic losses quantified.
cases.claim_ceiling: controlled lab point/range only; not whole-vehicle fuel economy or road safety

cases.target: No performance ranking unless load, surface, temperature and tire state are matched.
cases.promotion_gate: Safety fixture and instrumented test method approved; all runs and censored points retained.

cases.purpose: Lateral force, slip angle and camber
outputs: lateral force and aligning moment if instrumented
cases.target: No candidate is described as handling-superior from strain/TPMS data alone.
cases.promotion_gate: Controlled test rig or specialist closed-course protocol and independent safety review.
cases.claim_ceiling: measured conditions only; no roadworthiness implication

cases.method_reference: ISO 10231:2025 for applicable motorcycle tyre capability methods; add a reviewed wet-surface protocol because a generic tire capability test is not a complete wet-grip rating
cases.target: Research stretch: 10% shorter wet stopping distance than matched control in a pre-defined repeatable test, with no regression beyond the pre-registered measurement-based non-inferiority margin in other mandatory safety measures.
cases.promotion_gate: Closed course/test facility, matched controls, repeats, uncertainty and independent test approval; no public-road experimentation.

cases.purpose: Casing, bead, high-speed and endurance qualification
cases.method_reference: ISO 10231:2025 and applicable current tire approval requirements
cases.target: All mandatory capability and approval requirements pass. Optimization cannot trade away this gate.
cases.promotion_gate: Qualified independent laboratory and applicable approval authority where required.
cases.claim_ceiling: only exact test and approval scope

cases.target: Research stretch: 20% improvement on one pre-declared puncture or impact metric without worsening other mandatory safety requirements.
cases.promotion_gate: Controlled fixtures and specialist review; post-damage continued-use decisions follow the applicable safety policy.

cases.target: Research stretch: 20% increase in measured service life against matched baseline; publish specimen spread and confidence interval, not just the best tire.
cases.promotion_gate: Repeatable duty cycle and definition of end-of-life fixed before testing.
cases.claim_ceiling: life under stated duty cycle only

cases.data_reference: CC BY 4.0 passenger-car tire monitoring data may be used only for pressure/temp/speed telemetry methods; it is not a motorcycle performance reference.
cases.target: Zero segment leakage across train/test; zero claims of puncture/blowout detection unless tested for those events.
cases.promotion_gate: Whole runs stay within one split; sensor smoothing and missingness documented.
cases.claim_ceiling: pressure anomaly detection within represented event classes

cases.target: Research stretch: 15% lower life-cycle cost per tire-km against matched baseline at equivalent approved safety capability.
cases.promotion_gate: Quote/measurement-backed costs; safety not reduced to improve scalar score.
cases.claim_ceiling: declared region, usage and cost assumptions only

required_run_record: vehicle, wheel/rim, brake and load configuration
sensor IDs/calibration and sampled raw signals
units, frames, sampling rate, uncertainty and missingness
source rights, raw hash, transformation hash and evidence class
all runs, failed tests, censored values and pre-registered exclusion reasons
no_test_result_warning: This file specifies the experimental design and provisional R&D targets. It contains no measured tire performance data, no tire design that has passed qualification, and no road-use approval.
